sessionHeader: SYNTHETIC SESSION. Fictional client c01 (Ananya R.), session 2026-10-20. Not a real person.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Hi Ananya, good to see you. How have the last two weeks been?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Mixed. The notification thing helped, honestly. I turned off chat after 10 most nights.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Most nights. How many would you say?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Maybe five out of seven. The two nights I didn't were right before the release.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: And what happened to sleep on the nights you did turn it off?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: I fell asleep faster. Maybe 30, 35 minutes. On the release nights it was back to over an hour.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: That's a real difference. What do you make of it?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: That the phone is a big part of it. Which I kind of knew, but seeing it in the log made it obvious.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Did you keep the sleep log going?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Yes, I filled it every morning. I can send you a photo.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Please do, that would help. What about worry time at 7?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: I skipped it. Honestly it felt like homework on top of homework.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Okay. Let's keep it simple then. Which one felt more useful, the log or worry time?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: The log. And turning off notifications.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Then let's drop worry time for now and keep those two. How was the meeting step, asking one question?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: I did it in two meetings. The second time my voice shook a bit but nobody noticed.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: How anxious were you before and after?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Before maybe a six. After, three.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: That's a drop of three points, and you did it twice. What would the next step on your list be?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Presenting my own update in the weekly sync. That's scary.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Scary is okay if it's the right size. Would you want to try it once before we meet next?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Once, yes. If it's a short update.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: A short update then. Before the meeting, the breathing we practised, 4 in and 6 out.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: I can do that in the washroom before.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Good plan. Is there anything you want me to remember for next time?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Just that the release is on the 3rd, so that week will be bad.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Noted. Let's book the next session after the release, maybe the 5th?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: The 5th works. Evening if possible.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: I'll send you a WhatsApp reminder with the time.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Thanks. This felt like a good week, actually.
